_help: Charms: permanent upgrades earned during a run and lost when the run ends. 'from' is what grants it:
freed:<boss id>        when that boss is freed (freed:pell, freed:dova, freed:clerk)
clear:<build id>       when that level is cleared (clear:level:rooftops ...)
'effects' (all optional): maxHealth, maxKi (added); shiftCostMult, astralDrainMult, kiRegenMult, damageMult (multiplied).
Names and descriptions are shown in capitals, so keep them short.

charms.name: TITHE SEAL
charms.desc: STRIKES HIT HARDER, ASTRAL DRAINS LESS
